Hey,

So as many of you know voat almost the same voting system as reddit (voat uses a different algorithm to decide what gets higher on the front page). As every growing community you'll find people that disagree with you and downvote your content because they disagree with you.

Now some measures have been put in place against having people mass-downvoting people, eventually everybody will accumulate enough CCP to downvote and we'll have the same problem reddit faced by having an echo-chamber of the same opinions and puns.

That's why I propose to have a voting system based 3 parameters:

  • funny: if you think the comment is funny (circlejerky, being filled with puns, what I think /v/funny will become)

  • interesting: content which spark discussion and makes you think about its content (just as /v/changemyview or /v/FBHeaders

  • compelling: for content that's beautifully written (such as /v/drawingprompts)

This way there is no risk in having people use bad powers to exclude content from the public as they can only vote things up. Another advantage would be that people can sort threads to funny content if they would like to have a laugh. But if they want to see interesting content which foster discussion you can sort the thread by most "interesting" votes.

Trolls and spammers would automatically end up to end of threads as nobody shall choose a category for their content.

What do you guys think?

A majority of people will have no category for their content. the CCP system is inherently broken because it is a system of the haves and the have nots. A single user should not be more valuable than another. The only way this system will work is when the CCP system is removed entirely and all registered users are allowed to up and down vote as they please. The system is ripe for abuse and all the good will going on now is a facade that will show it's true colors during the first subverse or targeted user attack.
